styles.name: value-noise-fill
styles.description: Bilinear value noise lattice thresholded by progress — blobs of filled dots that slowly churn and spread as progress grows.

styles.name: fbm-contour
styles.description: Fractal Brownian motion fill: octave count rises with progress, so the bar starts smooth and gains turbulent detail as it nears 100%.

styles.name: gradient-noise-fill
styles.description: Perlin-style gradient noise thresholded by progress — smoother, more organic blobs than value noise, with a shimmering animated field.

styles.name: domain-warp
styles.description: Domain warping — sampling fBm at displaced coordinates — produces hypnotic, swirling tendrils that churn and grow with progress.

styles.name: flow-field
styles.description: Flow-field particles: each particle is advected along a noise-derived angle field, leaving a streak. Particle count grows with progress.

styles.name: worley-cell
styles.description: Worley cellular noise — distance to the nearest feature point — drawn as living cells: a nucleus at each point, solid F2−F1 membranes and a faint rim, revealed left-to-right with progress.

styles.name: voronoi-diagram
styles.description: Voronoi diagram with seed count growing with progress — cell boundaries shatter and multiply, revealing a cracked-glass pattern.

styles.name: dla-growth
styles.description: Diffusion-limited aggregation: random walkers drift in and stick on contact, growing branching dendrites off the left wall until the crystal reaches the progress point.

styles.name: brownian-trail
styles.description: Brownian motion: a single particle's 2-D random walk — tangled, self-crossing, wandering back on itself — drifts across the bar and reaches the progress point; its head jitters live.

styles.name: curl-noise
styles.description: Curl-noise streamlines: a divergence-free velocity field derived from the gradient of value noise — swirling, never-crossing filaments.

styles.name: topo-contour
styles.description: Topographic map: one-dot-thick isolines of an fBm height field nest into hills and basins, surveyed left-to-right as progress grows.

styles.name: plasma
styles.description: Classic demoscene plasma — superimposed sine waves of position, distance, and time — thresholded into a pulsing psychedelic fill.
